stage: Recovery-V1: oracle XY centre-before-release pilot (Phase A: preparation)

status.base_policy: FROZEN: Vision-V1 train seed 1, 80k EMA, unchanged

authorization.proposed_cap_is: a proposal, explicitly not an approval; earlier approvals are not inherited; a bare "proceed" is not an approval
authorization.needed: a separate explicit user instruction that states an exact USD cap AND names the SHA256 of this plan file
authorization.required_file: authorization.json in the run folder, written only after such an instruction: {"approved_by": "user", "paid_compute_authorized": true, "cap_usd": <number>, "plan_sha256": "<sha256 of this plan>"}

question: At the first pending release command of the frozen Vision-V1 policy, does an oracle-guided bounded horizontal correction improve final task success without turning many C0-successful scenes into failures, beyond the effect of interruption, holding and re-planning?

privileged_information.exception: exact simulator cube positions are read for control in ONE place (hci.recovery_v1_oracle.oracle_offset), only while the CENTER_ORACLE control part runs (OracleGate), every read counted per arm
privileged_information.never: the policy observation whitelist (rgb, qpos, qvel, tcp pose), the trigger, C0, R5 and HOLD_MATCHED receive no object pose
privileged_information.logging: ground truth is also written to traces after each step, as in the diagnostic; logging only
privileged_information.project_rule: AGENTS.md: "모니터/정책에 객체 정답 pose, task success, 미래 라벨을 입력하지 않습니다." The oracle value goes to a scripted reference controller, not to the monitor or the policy; AGENTS.md is not edited
privileged_information.claim: CENTER_ORACLE is not deployable; a gain is feasibility evidence only

base_policy.rule: frozen; not retrained, not fine-tuned, no other checkpoint

seed_registry.seed_level_check: no overlap with splits.json, policy_eval_splits.json, vision_v1_splits.json, recovery_v1_diag, the 550 demonstration scene seeds, or the scenes of Stage 2A / 2B / 2D / H1
seed_registry.placement_check: server step `scenes`: placements of the 100 pilot seeds against stored placements (demonstrations, earlier pilots) and, by reset, against audit / dev / policy-evaluation / Vision-V1 / diagnostic sets; calibration and Test by seed number only. An identical placement fails the step
seed_registry.no_replacement: no scene is replaced or dropped for any reason

trigger.rule: first control step at which ALL hold: (1) the action the policy will execute next has gripper command > 0 (open); (2) the 3 or more most recently executed gripper commands are all < 0 (close); (3) the measured finger opening (sum of the two finger joints in agent/qpos) is between 0.02 m and 0.06 m
trigger.inputs: the pending action, the executed actions, agent/qpos. No grasp flag, cube pose, task flag, outcome or future information
trigger.pending_action: the head of the unexecuted queue; if the queue is empty the next chunk is inferred at this step exactly as the policy would infer it (same noise key and counters)
trigger.capture: the full runtime (simulator by prefix replay, history, queue with the pending action, counters, RNG) BEFORE the pending action is executed
trigger.no_trigger: the scene stays in every denominator; every arm carries the outcome of the uninterrupted run; no continuation is run
trigger.false_trigger: cubeA not grasped or not lifted 1 cm at the trigger, read from ground truth AFTER the fact; recorded, never excluded; all four arms are still run
trigger.thresholds_from: gripper sign and limits from the pinned Panda source; the width window and the run length were chosen on the stored traces of the consumed diagnostic set (development data)

semantics.gripper_in_control_arms: R5, HOLD_MATCHED and CENTER_ORACLE keep the last executed gripper command, which the trigger guarantees to be a close command (< 0); a state where it is not is a technical stop. No arm ever commands the gripper open; the policy decides when to open after it gets control back
semantics.C0: the pending action and the rest of the queue are executed; history untouched; must equal the uninterrupted run (actions, outcome, final state), otherwise the run stops
semantics.R5: Runtime.retreat() unchanged (5 cm up, 5 mm per step, at most 40 steps, 5 mm arrival tolerance), queue cleared before and after, then normal re-inference. Runtime.force(2) is not used because its Stage-2 eligibility grid (step multiple of 4, inside a chunk, 48 steps left) does not contain the trigger step; the three statements of force() are executed without the grid. Secondary comparator only

CENTER_ORACLE.reads: exact simulator positions of cubeA and cubeB (horizontal offset between their centres), re-read every control step
CENTER_ORACLE.stops_when: offset <= 0.010 m, or 12 steps, or the target cap leaves no move, or the episode ends
CENTER_ORACLE.command: horizontal only, towards removing the offset, at most 0.005 m per control step (0.05 in normalised action); vertical command exactly 0; gripper command held
CENTER_ORACLE.target_cap: the commanded TCP target never leaves a horizontal distance of 0.030 m from the TCP position at the trigger
CENTER_ORACLE.cap_reading: "3 cm" bounds the commanded TARGET displacement (as `commanded_distance_m` of the existing retreat), not the sum of per-step commands; the sum is recorded and can reach 0.06 m in 12 steps. The alternative reading (sum of commands <= 0.03 m) would stop after 6 steps; see offline evidence
CENTER_ORACLE.after: queue cleared, the unchanged policy re-infers at trigger + T
CENTER_ORACLE.not: no forced opening, no teleport, no state write, no extra steps beyond the 200-step episode

semantics.HOLD_MATCHED: queue cleared; for exactly T control steps (T = the number of steps CENTER_ORACLE used on this state, from a controller-only reference run without policy inference) the TCP horizontal position of the trigger is held by feedback with the same 0.005 m bound, vertical command exactly 0, gripper command held; then the policy re-infers at trigger + T. Reads no object pose
semantics.zero_step_case: if the offset is already <= 0.010 m, T = 0: in BOTH arms the pending queue is discarded and the policy re-infers at the trigger step with the trigger-step noise key; both arms are run and must be identical
semantics.matched_handoff: HOLD_MATCHED and CENTER_ORACLE: no inference during control, empty queue at return, same number of control steps, first inference at trigger + T with one and the same seed; any difference stops the run
semantics.episode_end_during_control: an arm whose episode ends inside its control part keeps that outcome; nothing is re-run
semantics.noise: repeat 0 only; every inference is keyed by seed_for(scene, physical step, 0, 'dp')
semantics.restore: reset(seed) + prefix action replay; set_state is never used; the restored runtime is compared with the snapshot before every branch

analysis.primary: paired success_once_absorbing, CENTER_ORACLE against C0, on all 100 scenes: both succeed / rescue / harm / both fail, Net = rescue - harm, harm / C0 successes, Wilson intervals
secondary: TCP and cube displacement, vertical drift, offset before and after, grasp kept, release location, extra steps

followup_gate.otherwise: NO_ORACLE_GATE_PASS: the candidate is closed for this cycle; no extension, no tuning of bounds, no search for subsets

not_claimed: a comparison with 79/100 of earlier sets

audit.from: vision_v1_select (already used); outcomes on these scenes decide nothing
does: controller configuration: arm root-frame delta position, 0.1 m per unit, no virtual target; gripper normalised onto [-0.01, 0.04] m
the full four-arm procedure on each audit scene with every technical check of the pilot
tracking: from the trigger state, the bounded move towards four synthetic TCP targets (+-3 cm in x and y; no object pose): achieved displacement, per-step gain, direction, vertical drift, grasp kept
trunk outcome and step count against the Vision-V1 record (reported, does not block)
seconds per environment step for the budget gate
audit.on_failure: TECHNICAL_BLOCKED: the pilot set is not touched; no bound is changed

run.ledger: artifacts/ledger/recovery_v1_oracle_xy_pilot.json, created exclusively before any rollout; no resume, no second pass
run.on_error: the pass stops and stays INCOMPLETE; no scene is dropped or replaced; a partial run has no summary
run.after_two_scenes: a time-only re-projection of the total cost; above the cap the pass stops and is backed up (outcomes are not read for this)
run.stored: one record per scene, per-step ground-truth traces of the trunk, the reference and the four arms; no camera frames

offline_evidence.source: results/recovery_v1_diagnostic/run1 (100 stored traces of the consumed diagnostic set; development data)
offline_evidence.not: no simulator step and no policy inference were run for this file

tracking.what: achieved TCP displacement of one control step divided by the commanded increment (action x 0.1 m), steps with |command| > 2 mm, the policy's own motions
tracking.reading: about 0.39 of each commanded increment is achieved per control step (the controller re-targets from the measured pose every step). A 5 mm command moves the gripper about 2 mm. This agrees with the existing 5 cm retreat needing 23-27 steps.

consequence.target_cap_reading: at most 12 x 5 mm x 0.39 = about 2.3 cm of real correction; the 12-step limit binds before the 3 cm target cap
consequence.sum_of_commands_reading: at most 3 cm x 0.39 = about 1.2 cm of real correction, after 6 steps

trigger_on_consumed_traces.without_the_width_and_run_conditions: the first open-after-close command comes with empty fingers in 2 episodes (50610, 50626) and after a 1-step close in 1 (50636); the width window and the run length exclude these

predicted_correction.model: Linear tracking model: each step achieves g x the commanded increment; the carried cube moves with the gripper; cubeB does not move.
predicted_correction.caveat: a prediction about the controller, not about task success; the policy re-plans afterwards and may move again before it opens

upstream_sources.fetched_from: raw.githubusercontent.com/haosulab/ManiSkill at the pinned commit (this PC has no local checkout of the upstream repository)

read.robot: PandaWristCam (uid panda_wristcam) subclasses Panda and inherits its controller configurations
read.arm_pd_ee_delta_pos: PDEEPosControllerConfig(pos_lower=-0.1, pos_upper=0.1, stiffness=1e3, damping=1e2, force_limit=100); frame root_translation, use_delta, no virtual target (use_target is True only in the separate pd_ee_target_delta_pos mode), normalised action. The 3 arm values in [-1, 1] are scaled to [-0.1, 0.1] m and added to the CURRENT end-effector position in the robot base frame; the IK joint target is then driven by the joint PD controller
read.gripper: PDJointPosMimicControllerConfig(lower=-0.01, upper=0.04), absolute target, normalised action: command -1 -> -0.01 m per finger (closed, squeezing), +1 -> 0.04 m per finger (open)
read.consequence: because there is no virtual target, the target is re-anchored at the measured pose every control step: the part of a commanded increment that was not achieved is not carried over to the next step

upstream_sources.still_to_verify_on_the_server: the same facts read from the live controller objects (audit step, controller_facts) and the achieved motion (tracking audit). Nothing in this file was executed
